verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ because God wanted it. To the saints (holy people) at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in heavenly places in Christ.
God chose us in Christ before the world was made. God chose us to be holy and without blame before Him in love.
We were predestinated (chosen ahead of time) to be adopted as God's children by Jesus Christ. God did this because it pleased Him and He wanted it.
This is to the praise of the glory of God's grace. By His grace God has made us accepted in the Beloved (His dear Son).
In the Son we have redemption (being bought back and set free) through His blood. Our sins are forgiven, because God's grace is so rich.
God has poured out this grace on us richly, in all wisdom and understanding.
God has made known to us the mystery (secret) of what He wants. This was His own good plan, which He decided on in Himself.
God's plan is this: when the time is full, God will gather together all things in Christ. God will gather things in heaven and things on earth, all in Christ.
In Christ we also have received an inheritance. We were predestinated (chosen ahead of time) by God's plan. God works out everything the way He wants.
God did this so that we, who first trusted in Christ, would bring praise to His glory.
You also trusted in Christ after you heard the word of truth, the good news of your salvation. After you believed, you were sealed (marked as God's own) with the Holy Spirit of promise.

The Holy Spirit is the earnest (first payment) of our inheritance. The Spirit is our promise until the redemption (being bought back and set free) of those God has bought as His own. All this is to the praise of His glory.
For this reason, I also heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints (holy people).
So I never stop thanking God for you. I remember you in my prayers.
I pray that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, will give you the spirit of wisdom and revelation (showing). Then you will know God better.

I pray that the eyes of your understanding will be filled with light. Then you will know the hope of God's calling. You will know the riches of the glory of God's inheritance in the saints (holy people).
And you will know how very great God's power is toward us who believe. It is the working of God's mighty power.
God used this power in Christ when God raised Christ from the dead. God set Christ at His own right hand in the heavenly places.
Christ is far above every ruler, power, might, and lord. Christ is above every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in the world to come.
God has put all things under Christ's feet. God gave Christ to be head over all things for the church.
The church is Christ's body. The church is the fulness of Christ, who fills all things everywhere.

1.source: Rewritten 2026-11-15 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase), following the KJV's Greek text (Textus Receptus, checked against Moorman's 8,000 Differences), at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses.

verses.text: And God made you alive. You were dead in trespasses (wrongs) and sins.

In the past you lived the way this world lives. You followed the prince of the power of the air (the devil). The devil is the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience (people who disobey God).

All of us also lived among them in the past. We lived by the lusts (wrong desires) of our flesh. We did what our flesh and our minds wanted. By nature we were children of wrath (God's anger), just like everyone else.
But God is rich in mercy. God loved us with a great love.
Even when we were dead in sins, God made us alive together with Christ. By grace you are saved.
And God has raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus.
God did this so that in the ages to come, God might show the great riches of His grace. God shows it by His kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
For by grace you are saved through faith. It is not from yourselves. It is the gift of God.
It is not from works (the good things we do), so that no one can boast (brag).
For we are God's workmanship (what God has made). We are created in Christ Jesus to do good works. God planned these good works ahead of time, so that we would live in them.

So remember what you were in the past. You were Gentiles (people who are not Jews) by birth. The Jews called you the Uncircumcision. The Jews called themselves the Circumcision, because of what was done to their bodies by human hands.
At that time you were without Christ. You were outsiders, not part of the nation of Israel. You were strangers to the agreements of promise. You had no hope, and you were without God in the world.
But now in Christ Jesus, you who were once far away are brought near by the blood of Christ.
For Christ is our peace. Christ has made both groups one. Christ has broken down the wall in the middle that separated us.

In His flesh, Christ ended the enmity (hate) between us. That enmity (hate) was the law of commands and rules. Christ did this to make the two groups into one new man in Himself. In this way Christ made peace.
Christ did this to reconcile (bring back to God) both groups in one body by the cross. By the cross Christ killed the enmity (hate).
Christ came and preached peace to you who were far away, and to those who were near.
For through Christ we both can come to the Father by one Spirit.
So now you are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are fellow citizens with the saints (holy people), and part of the household (family) of God.
You are built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets. Jesus Christ Himself is the chief corner stone (the most important stone).
In Christ the whole building is joined together. It grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
In Christ you also are built together into a place where God lives through the Spirit.

verses.text: For this reason I, Paul, am the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles (people who are not Jews).
You have surely heard about the dispensation (work) of God's grace. God gave it to me for you.
By revelation (showing) God made known to me the mystery (secret). I wrote a little about this before.
When you read it, you can understand my knowledge of the mystery (secret) of Christ.
In other ages this was not made known to people. But now it is revealed (shown) to God's holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit.
This is the mystery (secret): the Gentiles (people who are not Jews) are fellow heirs. They are part of the same body. They share in God's promise in Christ by the good news.
I was made a minister (servant) of this good news. It was the gift of God's grace given to me by the working of His power.

I am less than the least of all saints (holy people). Yet God gave this grace to me. God gave it so that I would preach among the Gentiles (people who are not Jews) the unsearchable (too great to measure) riches of Christ.

God also gave this grace so that I would make everyone see the fellowship (sharing) of the mystery (secret). From the beginning of the world this mystery (secret) was hidden in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ.
God wants the rulers and powers in heavenly places to know now the many sides of God's wisdom. They will know it by the church.
This was God's eternal plan, which God planned in Christ Jesus our Lord.
In Christ we have boldness. We can come to God with confidence by faith in Christ.
So I ask you not to faint (lose heart) because of my troubles for you. My troubles are your glory.
For this reason I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
The whole family in heaven and on earth is named after the Father.
I pray that the Father will give you strength from the riches of His glory. I pray that you will be made strong with might by His Spirit in the inner man (your inner self).
I pray that Christ will live in your hearts by faith. I pray that you will be rooted and grounded (built firmly) in love.
Then you will be able to understand, with all the saints (holy people), how wide, how long, how deep, and how high Christ's love is.
I pray that you will know the love of Christ, which is greater than knowledge. Then you will be filled with all the fulness of God.
Now God is able to do far more than all we ask or think, by the power that works in us.
To God be glory in the church by Christ Jesus through all ages, forever and ever. Amen.

verses.text: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech (beg) you that you walk worthy of the vocation (calling) with which you are called,
With all lowliness (humbleness) and meekness (gentleness), with longsuffering (patience), forbearing (putting up with) one another in love,
Endeavouring (working hard) to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you are called in one hope of your calling,
One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
But to every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
Therefore He says: When He ascended (went up) on high, He led captivity captive (led away the captives), and gave gifts to men.
Now that He ascended (went up), what does it mean but that He also descended (came down) first into the lower parts of the earth?
He who descended (came down) is the same also who ascended (went up) far above all heavens, that He might fill all things.
And He gave some to be apostles (sent ones), and some prophets, and some evangelists (those who tell the good news), and some pastors and teachers,
For the perfecting (making complete) of the saints (holy people), for the work of the ministry (serving), for the edifying (building up) of the body of Christ,
Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a perfect (full-grown) man, to the measure of the stature (full size) of the fulness of Christ,

That we from now on be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine (teaching), by the sleight (trickery) of men, and cunning craftiness, by which they lie in wait to deceive (fool),
But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into Him in all things, who is the head, even Christ,

From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted (held together) by that which every joint supplies, according to the effectual (powerful) working in the measure of every part, makes increase (growth) of the body to the edifying (building up) of itself in love.
This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you from now on do not walk as other Gentiles (people who are not Jews) walk, in the vanity (emptiness) of their mind,
Having the understanding darkened, being alienated (cut off) from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart,
Who being past feeling have given themselves over to lasciviousness (shameless sexual desire), to work all uncleanness (impure living) with greediness.
But you have not so learned Christ,
If so be that you have heard Him, and have been taught by Him, as the truth is in Jesus,
That you put off concerning the former conversation (way of life) the old man (old self), which is corrupt (rotten) according to the deceitful lusts (wrong desires),
And be renewed (made new) in the spirit of your mind,
And that you put on the new man (new self), which after God is created in righteousness (being right with God) and true holiness.
Therefore putting away lying, let everyone speak truth with their neighbour. For we are members one of another.
Be angry, and do not sin. Do not let the sun go down on your wrath (anger).
Neither give place (room) to the devil.
Let the one who stole steal no more. But rather let them labour (work hard), working with their hands the thing which is good, that they may have something to give to the one who needs.
Let no corrupt (rotten) communication (talk) proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying (building up), that it may minister (give) grace to the hearers.
And do not grieve (make sad) the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you are sealed (marked as God's own) to the day of redemption (being bought back and set free).
Let all bitterness, and wrath (rage), and anger, and clamour (shouting), and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice (hate).
And be kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake has forgiven you.

verses.text: Be therefore followers of God, as dear children,
And walk in love, as Christ also has loved us, and has given Himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour (smell).

But fornication (sexual sin), and all uncleanness (impure living), or covetousness (wanting what belongs to others), let it not be once named among you, as becomes (is right for) saints (holy people),
Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting (dirty joking), which are not convenient (fitting), but rather giving of thanks.

For this you know, that no whoremonger (person who does sexual sin), nor unclean person, nor covetous (greedy) man, who is an idolater (one who worships idols), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
Let no one deceive (fool) you with vain (empty) words. For because of these things comes the wrath (anger) of God on the children of disobedience (people who disobey God).
Do not be therefore partakers (sharers) with them.
For you were sometimes (once) darkness, but now are you light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness (being right with God) and truth,
Proving (testing and finding out) what is acceptable to the Lord.
And have no fellowship (sharing) with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove (show the wrong of) them.
For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done by them in secret.
But all things that are reproved (shown to be wrong) are made manifest (plain to see) by the light. For whatever makes manifest (plain to see) is light.
Therefore He says: Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will give you light.
See then that you walk circumspectly (carefully), not as fools, but as wise,
Redeeming (buying back) the time, because the days are evil.
Therefore do not be unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
And do not be drunk with wine, in which is excess (wild living), but be filled with the Spirit,
Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord,
Giving thanks always for all things to God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church. And He is the saviour of the body.
Therefore as the church is subject to Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in everything.
Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave Himself for it,
That He might sanctify (make holy) and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
That He might present it to Himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing, but that it should be holy and without blemish (fault).
So men ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
For no man ever yet hated his own flesh (body), but nourishes (feeds) and cherishes (cares for) it, even as the Lord the church.
For we are members of His body, of His flesh, and of His bones.
For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will be joined to his wife, and the 2 of them will be one flesh.
This is a great mystery (secret), but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself. And the wife see that she reverence (respect) her husband.

verses.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
Honour your father and mother, which is the first commandment with promise,
That it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.
And, you fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath (anger), but bring them up in the nurture (training) and admonition (warning and teaching) of the Lord.
Servants, be obedient to those who are your masters according to the flesh (here on earth), with fear and trembling, in singleness (honesty) of your heart, as to Christ,
Not with eyeservice (working only when watched), as menpleasers (people pleasers), but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men,
Knowing that whatever good thing anyone does, the same will they receive from the Lord, whether they are bond (slave) or free.
And, you masters, do the same things to them, forbearing (holding back from) threatening, knowing that your Master also is in heaven. Neither is there respect of persons (favoring anyone) with Him.
Finally, my brothers, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of His might.
Put on the whole armour of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles (tricks) of the devil.

For we wrestle not against flesh and blood (people), but against principalities (rulers), against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
Therefore take to you the whole armour of God, that you may be able to withstand (stand against) in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
Stand therefore, having your loins (waist) girt about (tied) with truth, and having on the breastplate (chest armor) of righteousness (being right with God),
And your feet shod (wearing shoes) with the preparation of the gospel (good news) of peace.
Above all, taking the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench (put out) all the fiery darts (burning arrows) of the wicked.
And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God,

Praying always with all prayer and supplication (asking) in the Spirit, and watching thereunto (staying alert for this) with all perseverance (never giving up) and supplication (asking) for all saints (holy people),
And for me, that utterance (words) may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery (secret) of the gospel (good news),
For which I am an ambassador (messenger) in bonds (chains), that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
But that you also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved (dearly loved) brother and faithful minister (servant) in the Lord, will make known to you all things,
Whom I have sent to you for the same purpose, that you might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity (with an honest heart). Amen.
